input.summary: Cut the Company's non-renewal notice window to 30 days (HDI's 90-day window retained) and add a 60-day renewal reminder.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have cut our own non-renewal notice window from 90 days to 30 days' written notice (HDI's 90-day window is untouched) and added an HDI reminder 60 days before each automatic renewal, so the 12-month auto-renewal remains easy for us to exit.

ops.oldText: either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: the Company upon 30 days', or HDI upon ninety (90) days, written notice to the other

ops.text: HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than 60 days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.
